title: How to Make a Chocolate Cake
content:
Chocolate cake is a popular dessert that can be prepared for birthdays, family gatherings, or simply to enjoy at home. With a few basic ingredients and some patience, it is possible to make a soft and delicious cake.

Ingredients

For the cake, you will need 2 cups of all-purpose flour, 1 cup of sugar, 1 cup of cocoa powder, 1 cup of milk, ½ cup of vegetable oil, 2 eggs, 1 tablespoon of baking powder, and a pinch of salt.

For the filling, you will need 1 can of condensed milk, 1 tablespoon of butter, and 3 tablespoons of cocoa powder.

For the topping, you will need 200 grams of chocolate, ½ cup of heavy cream, and chocolate sprinkles.

Preparation

First, preheat the oven to 180°C. Grease a cake pan with butter and sprinkle it with a little flour.

In a large bowl, mix the eggs, sugar, and oil. Add the milk and mix everything well. Then, gradually add the flour, cocoa powder, and salt. Stir until the batter becomes smooth and there are no large lumps.

Finally, add the baking powder and mix gently. Pour the batter into the prepared pan and bake it for approximately 35 to 40 minutes. To check if the cake is ready, insert a toothpick into the center. If it comes out clean, the cake can be removed from the oven.

Allow the cake to cool completely before cutting it.

Filling

To prepare the filling, place the condensed milk, butter, and cocoa powder in a saucepan. Cook the mixture over medium-low heat while stirring constantly.

After several minutes, the mixture will become thicker and creamy. When it starts to come away from the bottom of the pan, turn off the heat and let the filling cool.

Once the cake has cooled, cut it carefully in half horizontally. Spread the chocolate filling evenly over the bottom layer and place the other layer on top.

Topping

To prepare the topping, melt the chocolate using a microwave or a double boiler. Add the heavy cream and mix until the texture becomes smooth and shiny.

Pour the chocolate topping over the cake and spread it carefully with a spoon or spatula. Chocolate sprinkles can be added on top for decoration.

The cake should rest for a few minutes before being served. For a softer texture and a richer flavor, it can also be refrigerated for a few hours.

This chocolate cake is simple to prepare, but the combination of the soft cake, creamy filling, and smooth chocolate topping makes it a delicious dessert for almost any occasion.
